snippet.title: HEXA — Now available on Steam!
snippet.description:
HEXA is now available on Steam, for Windows, macOS, and Linux (even your Steam Deck)! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4581230/HEXA

HEXA is a "revolutionary" match-six twist on the logic puzzle genre. Rule the universe, shape by shape, as you match hexagons of similar colors. Featuring multiple modes, over 50 "Missions" to complete, and even the ability to create your own!

New and exclusive to the Steam version... full support for on-line leaderboards, rich presence, and Steam achievements amp up the HEXA-matching to the next level!

HEXA is also available on Itch.io: https://raewtf.itch.io/hexa
...and in Playdate Catalog: https://play.date/games/hexa

🪐 For more, visit https://rae.wtf
